text: More evidence (worker7, rubw round, 2026-09-09): test_edhoc_responder.py flaps with NO concurrent load — same file passed 38/38 then failed 2/38 (test_close_uses_definitive_publication_result[True], test_failed_message_3_is_removed_and_fresh_handshake_succeeds) on immediate rerun; also failed on a stashed baseline (pre-existing, not change-induced).
